scope: Four illustrative cases from frozen rankings and title/abstract inspection. Not an exhaustive error rate or a causal ablation of max pooling.

cases.observation: The adolescent-only study moves from Dense rank 2 to reranked rank 6; direct MedCPT can bring in a separately judged adult transdiagnostic iCBT meta-analysis outside the Dense top ten.
Broad adult GAD/panic or mixed-anxiety treatment summaries precede more directly useful GAD/antidepressant evidence under the existing rubric.
Direct MedCPT places a mobile-CBT review at rank 2 whose results combine ages 13–25, without separate adolescent estimates. The maximum-scoring window is the METHOD section.
A review of study designs is promoted above several direct symptom-outcome reports. This is thematic relevance with weaker answer-specific usefulness under the existing rubric.
